label: Modal collapse: at every world, whatever…, from Scott's axiom A1a: at every world, for… and 7 more
meaning: Discriminator consequence: the premises of SCOTT-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS entail modal collapse, so in this embedding every truth is necessary. The AFP theory states MC and leaves it unproved in Isabelle (oops); the Lean proof is this repository's. It composes SCOTT-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS (T1, C, T2, T3) with C2. Formal consequence inside the Lean embedding of QML KB (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY) only: it shows nothing about what Gödel or Scott intended, nor that the axioms are true.
